view_frame: Front view (left) shows the XZ plane (width and height). Right view (right) shows the YZ plane (depth and height). The object is an L-shaped bookend with a vertical back panel and a horizontal base.

features.placement: Vertical panel located at the back of the base. Extends from Z=0 to Z=height. Centered on X axis.
features.evidence: Vertical leg of the L-shape in the right view. Rectangular outline in the front view.

features.placement: Horizontal plate at the bottom. Extends from Z=0 to Z=thickness. Extends from Y=0 to Y=depth.
features.evidence: Horizontal leg of the L-shape in the right view. Bottom section of the front view.

features.placement: Rectangular cutout in the upper portion of the back panel. Centered on X axis.
features.evidence: Rectangular outline in the upper center of the front view.

features.placement: Rectangular cutout in the lower left portion of the back panel.
features.evidence: Rectangular outline in the lower left of the front view.

features.placement: Rectangular cutout in the center of the back panel.
features.evidence: Rectangular outline in the center of the front view.

features.placement: Rectangular cutout in the lower right portion of the back panel.
features.evidence: Rectangular outline in the lower right of the front view.

connections: back_panel and base_plate are joined at the bottom edge of the back panel and the back edge of the base plate.
cutout_top, cutout_left, cutout_center, and cutout_right are subtracted from the back_panel.
edit_rules: Changing the width of the back_panel must update the width of the base_plate to maintain alignment.
Changing the height of the back_panel must update the height of the cutouts to maintain relative positioning.
Changing the thickness of the back_panel must update the depth of the cutouts to ensure they pass through.
